answers.question: How many visitors below age 30 are there?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visitor WHERE age < 30

answers.question: Find the names of the visitors whose membership level is higher than 4, and order the results by the level from high to low.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT v.name FROM visitor v WHERE v.level_of_membership > 4 ORDER BY v.level_of_membership DESC

answers.question: What are the opening year and staff number of the museum named Plaza Museum?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT open_year, num_of_staff FROM museum WHERE name = 'Plaza Museum'

answers.question: find the id, name and age for visitors who visited some museums more than once.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT id, name, age FROM visitor WHERE id IN (SELECT visitor_id FROM visit GROUP BY visitor_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

answers.question: What are the id, name and membership level of visitors who have spent the largest amount of money in total in all museum tickets?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT id, name, level_of_membership FROM visitor WHERE id = (SELECT visitor_id FROM visit ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1)

answers.question: What is the name of the museum that had no visitor yet?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT name FROM museum WHERE museum_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT museum_id FROM visit)

answers.question: What are the average and maximum number of tickets bought in all visits?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT AVG(num_of_ticket) AS avg_tickets, MAX(num_of_ticket) AS max_tickets FROM visit

answers.question: Find the number of visitors who did not visit any museum opened after 2010.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT COUNT(*) as num_visitors FROM visitor WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT visitor_id FROM visit WHERE museum_id IN (SELECT museum_id FROM museum WHERE open_year > 2010))

answers.question: Find the name of tourney that has more than 10 matches.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT tourney_name FROM matches GROUP BY tourney_name, tourney_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
